legal.tosUseText: Everyone can use this app to find public recipes, but it requires an account and active consent to data processing as described in the privacy policy to create and manage recipes.
legal.tosContentText: Users may create both private and public recipes.
legal.tosContentPrivate: Private recipes are only visible to the user.
legal.tosContentPublic: Public recipes are visible to everyone.
legal.tosPublicText: Public recipes are considered public contributions. When an account is deleted, public recipes remain available but are anonymized. Users who wish to remove public recipes must delete them before deleting their account.
legal.tosConsentText: Consent is required to create and manage recipes. If a user withdraws their consent, this is done by deleting the account. Deleting an account removes all personal data and private recipes.
legal.gdprIntro: This app will only collect the minimum amount of data requierd to function. The following data is collected:
legal.gdprConsent: Confirmation that the user has agreed to the terms of service
legal.gdprSensitive: No sensitive personal data is collected. All data is stored in a database.
legal.gdprStorage: User consent is required before an account can be created.
legal.gdprWithdraw: If the user wants to withdraw the constent, the user account must be deleted.
legal.privacyCollectedIntro: The app only collects the data necessary to identify users and provide the service
legal.privacyCollectedMetadata: No additional personal information is collected.
legal.privacyWhyTitle: Why does this need to be collected?
legal.privacyWhyRecipes: Allow users to create and manage recipes
legal.privacyWhyVisibility: Distinguish between private and public content
legal.privacyDeleteIntro: Users may delete their account at any time. When the account is deleted:
legal.privacyDeleteUserData: All personal user data is removed
legal.privacyDeletePublicRecipes: Public recipes remain available, but without any identifying information. Users who wish to remove public recipes must delete them before deleting their account.
